scenario: Regex flags are an unordered set per LREG.5.3 — `/foo/im` and `/foo/mi` are equivalent. Pin: `/pattern/im` (case-insensitive + multiline in either order) compiles cleanly.
rules_ds:
schema Msg scope logical:
    entity_id: String key
    text: String mutable

rule r:
    Msg m where m.text ~ /hello world/im
->
    log info "matched"
